# Brevlin M27 Monitor: Product Information Sheet

Product information in the format required for the energy label and the product data file. All values are for the standard configuration unless a field states otherwise.

## Product identification

Product family: Brevlin M-series office monitor
Model code: M27
Panel type: IPS, matte finish

## Product data

| No. | Field | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Energy class | E (on a scale from A to G) |
| 2 | Power consumption in on mode | 24 W |
| 3 | Power consumption in standby mode | 0.4 W |
| 4 | Screen diagonal | 27 inches |
| 5 | Resolution | 2560 x 1440 px |
| 6 | Refresh rate | 165 Hz |
| 7 | Response time, grey to grey | 1 ms |
| 8 | Brightness, typical | 300 cd/m2 |
| 9 | Contrast ratio, static | 1000:1 |
| 10 | Viewing angle, horizontal and vertical | 178 degrees |

## Connectivity

The monitor has one DisplayPort 1.4 input, one HDMI 2.0 input and one USB-C input that carries video, data and up to 65 W of charging power for a laptop. It also provides a 3.5 mm audio output for headphones.

## Ergonomics

The stand adjusts in height over a range of 110 mm. The screen tilts from minus 5 to plus 21 degrees, swivels 45 degrees to either side and rotates 90 degrees into portrait orientation. The mounting pattern on the rear is compatible with a 100 mm VESA standard arm.

## Power and energy notes

The on-mode power in field 2 is measured at maximum brightness with the standard test pattern. Typical office use with brightness at 150 cd/m2 lowers the on-mode consumption. The monitor switches to standby automatically when no video signal is detected for 5 minutes. Automatic power-off in network standby is disabled by default and can be enabled in the on-screen menu.

## Compliance

The monitor complies with the applicable European directives for electrical equipment, electromagnetic compatibility and restriction of hazardous substances. The declaration of conformity is available on the product support page. The energy label is supplied in the box and must be affixed to the front of any retail display unit.

## Environmental data

The packaging is made from recycled paperboard. The monitor can be returned to a collection point for electrical waste at the end of its life. The product contains no batteries and no mercury-based lamps.

## Operating conditions

Operating temperature: 0 to 40 degrees Celsius. Relative humidity during operation: 10 to 80 percent, without condensation. Storage temperature: minus 20 to 60 degrees Celsius.

## Included accessories

The box contains the monitor with its stand attached, one power cable with a three-pin plug, one DisplayPort cable of 1.8 m, one USB-C to USB-C cable of 1 m, and one quick start sheet. The stand base is packed separately from the screen to protect the panel during transport. The energy label is attached to the outer face of the carton and must be kept with the product documentation.

## Assembly notes

Assemble the stand on a flat, stable surface with the screen laid face down on a soft cloth. Attach the column to the base first, then fit the head into the rear mount until it clicks. Do not lift the monitor by the stand column alone, and do not apply pressure to the panel during assembly.

## Revision

Revision 3 of this sheet replaces revision 2. The values in fields 1 to 10 were measured with firmware version 1.6 of the on-screen display. Changes to firmware can alter the values in fields 2 and 3 and require a new revision of this sheet.
